text: Most men complicate dating with false beliefs. They think, I need money first, I need perfect looks, I need high status. And even though looks, money, and status are important in dating, and you should definitely work on these aspects of your life, the truth is simpler. The most effective way to get better is by doing. By approaching women, by asking them out, by making mistakes after mistakes, by failing over and over again. If you are postponing this until you get six packs or a CEO position, you are simply procrastinating. This is not a preparation. This is a fear disguised as logic. Another false belief is that someone will help you with your fears. Some guys think, a psychologist will cure my fear of women. No. Therapy can help you understand your patterns, but it won't give you courage. Only real world actions kill fear. Guys, if you find this advice useful, hit like, subscribe, and please share it with a friend who overthinks dating. Another misconception is labeling women as easy versus hard. And while this is not totally wrong, that is simply ineffective thinking. If a girl looks very hot, it doesn't automatically mean she is super hard to get. Moreover, girls can have different tastes. If one guy approached her and was not successful, it doesn't mean you now don't have a chance. Once again, you figure it out by taking actions. And finally, stop imagining that women sit there with some secret master plan to test you. Sure, they may subconsciously check what type of person you are, but most of the time they are just seeing if you are normal, fun, and someone they would enjoy spending time with. So stop overthinking. Simplify. Your actions are what matter most.
